items.question: What services does Robotrick offer?
items.answer: We provide three main services: Professional training programs in robotics, AI, and technology; custom technical projects including robotics and automation solutions; and professional 3D printing services from prototyping to production.

items.question: Do I need prior experience for training programs?
items.answer: Not at all! Our training courses are designed for all levels, from complete beginners (ages 6+) to advanced learners. We start from the fundamentals and build up systematically.

items.question: Can you build custom technical projects for businesses?
items.answer: Absolutely! We specialize in custom robotics solutions, automation systems, and IoT projects. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements and we'll design a solution tailored to your needs.

items.question: What 3D printing materials do you work with?
items.answer: We work with PLA, ABS, PETG, TPU, and specialty filaments. Our services range from rapid prototyping to production runs, with typical turnaround times of 24-48 hours.

items.question: Do students receive certificates upon course completion?
items.answer: Yes! Students who successfully complete their training program and final project receive an official Robotrick certificate recognized across Syria.

engineeringDesign.desc: Advanced robotics design program covering mechanical structures, motion simulation, and engineering analysis to build a fully integrated robot ready for manufacturing.
features: Designing mechanical robot parts: frames, arms, and mounts for motors and sensors
Assembly and motion simulation to ensure full-system performance
Stress, loads, center-of-mass, and inertia analysis for stability
Engineering drawings for manufacturing using CNC or 3D printing plus a full robot team project
